wow_goals: High-end Apple-style frosted glass UI with fluid motion
Data-driven knowledge graph for semantic discovery
north_star_experience: A seamless, liquid-like browsing experience where users navigate through a universe of products using natural gestures and semantic connections, feeling like they are manipulating physical objects under glass.

reasoning: React ecosystem offers the best libraries for WebGL (R3F) and D3 integration.
Component-based architecture essential for complex interactive modules like the Knowledge Graph and 3D Viewer.
TypeScript provides necessary type safety for complex data structures in the graph.
why_not_others: Vue: Good, but R3F ecosystem is stronger than TresJS for this specific high-fidelity 3D requirement.
Svelte: Excellent performance, but fewer drop-in advanced 3D/graph libraries compared to React.

frontier_candidates_considered.name: React Three Fiber
why_considered: Declarative scene graph matches React mental model

frontier_candidates_considered.name: D3.js
why_considered: Best in class for force-directed graphs
decision_reason: Essential for the Knowledge Graph visualization requirements.

frontier_candidates_considered.name: Framer Motion
decision_reason: Critical for the 'morphing' and 'fluid' feel described in design system.

interaction_bets: Seamless shared element transitions between list and detail

generative_art_strategy.combination_approach: Layered: Fluid WebGL background (Mode A) + D3 Force Graph foreground (Mode B)
generative_art_strategy.integration_method: React context for shared state, Canvas layers for performance

reasoning: Complexity of 3D, Graph, and UI logic requires separation of concerns.

internal_interaction_plan.navigation_scheme: Client-side routing (React Router) with Framer Motion transitions
internal_interaction_plan.state_management: Zustand for global store (cart, user preferences, graph state)
internal_interaction_plan.component_communication: Props for simple hierarchy, Context/Store for cross-cutting concerns (theme, data)
internal_interaction_plan.data_flow: Unidirectional data flow, local state for UI interactions
internal_interaction_plan.animation_orchestration: Framer Motion AnimatePresence for page exits/enters

fallback_plan: Static gradient background if WebGL fails
brand_experience_notes: Glassmorphism must be performant (backdrop-filter usage carefully monitored)
Typography must remain legible over complex backgrounds
